seoTitle: CAC and LTV:CAC Ratio Calculator with Payback Period
metaDescription: Calculate customer acquisition cost, lifetime value, LTV to CAC ratio and CAC payback months from spend, margin and lifespan.
intro: Enter spend, new customers, revenue, margin and lifespan to get CAC, LTV, the ratio and payback.
why:
CAC alone says little. Set against what a customer returns, it shows whether growth pays for itself, and how many months it takes to earn the acquisition cost back.

LTV here is gross profit over the lifespan, or over 1 divided by monthly churn if you enter churn. The 3:1 ratio is a common rule of thumb, not a law. Count salaries and tools in the spend for an honest CAC.
howTo: Enter marketing and sales spend and new customers for a period.
Enter revenue per customer per month and margin.
Read CAC, LTV, ratio and payback.

faq.a: It is a common benchmark. Context such as cash and growth stage matters.
Use the same period for spend and new customers.
The tool uses gross profit via margin.
